path_to_20.verdict: Expected from the current book is about 13 listings. 20 needs every source at its ceiling: 2 from listed, 5 from b7, 5 from b6_fresh, 3 from b5, 2 from b4, 2 from b3_fresh, 1 from b2_fresh. That is 42 more report calls held in 9 working days before 11-20 (4.7 a day, with 1 booked ahead today). The floor of 15 is reachable only if the calendar carries 3 held calls a day from tomorrow.
